items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'I need a clarinet player. Could you play with us for two days'

ctx.x: Yes. Time had passed. Anyway, they worked with us for the three days. In the meantime, Martel had a job for two days, and he asked me...old man Albert asked me, he said, 'What are you going to do...' I think the last night we worked... We didn't work at night, we played in the daytime and out in the open. He said, 'I need a clarinet player. Could you play with us for two days
